where.if: AND (p.place_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.add1 LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.sql: p.place_id AS placeId, p.place_name AS placeName, p.add1 AS add1, p.add2 AS add2, p.tel AS tel, p.content_type_id AS contentTypeId, p.map_x AS mapX, p.map_y AS mapY, p.first_image AS firstImage, p.radius_meters AS radiusMeters, p.is_active AS isActive, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.deleted_at AS deletedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visit v WHERE v.place_id = p.place_id) AS visitCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place_quiz_info pqi WHERE pqi.place_id = p.place_id AND pqi.is_active = TRUE) AS quizSetCnt
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM place p
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.place_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO place (place_name, add1, add2, tel, content_type_id, map_x, map_y, first_image, lcls_systm1, lcls_systm2, lcls_systm3, radius_meters, created_at, updated_at, is_active) VALUES (#{req.placeName}, #{req.add1}, #{req.add2OrEmpty}, #{req.telOrEmpty}, #{req.contentTypeIdOrDefault}, #{req.mapXOrZero}, #{req.mapYOrZero}, #{req.firstImageOrEmpty}, '', '', '', #{req.radiusMetersOrDefault}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt}, TRUE)
